claims.subject: Plukon Deutschland
claims.object: 7 operations: 3 slaughter plants, 2 processing plants and 2 hatcheries
claims.claim: Plukon states that its German business has seven operations comprising three slaughter plants, two processing plants and two hatcheries, with about 2,500 employees.
claims.boundary: A group-level operation count does not resolve the legal operator, capacity or animal origin for every site.
claims.falsification_condition: A current Plukon disclosure materially changes the German site, function or employee counts.

claims.subject: Plukon Storkow slaughter plant
claims.claim: Plukon states that its Storkow slaughter plant slaughters around 125,000 animals per day and that a large share of the chicken products produced there are sold in Germany under the Friki brand.
claims.boundary: The site-to-brand statement does not identify individual farms, batches, retailers or every product made at Storkow.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official facility source materially changes the throughput or product/brand relationship.

claims.subject: Plukon Agri Deutschland GmbH
claims.object: live-animal purchasing/sales, stocking numbers and animal offtake with farmers
claims.claim: Plukon identifies Plukon Agri Deutschland GmbH as responsible for live-animal purchasing and sales, coordinating stocking numbers and animal offtake and acting as a bridge to agricultural partners.
claims.boundary: This establishes an intermediary role but not the destination facility of a named farm or flock.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or corporate record materially changes Plukon Agri's role.

claims.subject: Plukon German hatchery network
claims.object: chicks to German growers within a 5xD origin concept
claims.claim: Plukon states that its German hatchery operations supply chicks to growers in Germany and describes those animals as a basis of its 5xD origin concept; the group also says Munsterhuis cooperates with certified breeding farms for hatching eggs.
claims.boundary: This does not identify every breeding farm, grower, flock destination or slaughter plant in the chain.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the hatchery/grower/origin model.

claims.subject: Plukon Deutschland
claims.claim: Plukon states that it is a member of Initiative Tierwohl and that around 80 percent of its animals in Germany currently come from the ITW programme.
claims.boundary: Programme participation is not proof of compliance in every individual case or of a measured animal-outcome improvement across the whole system.
claims.falsification_condition: A current Plukon or ITW disclosure materially changes the programme membership or share.

claims.subject: Plukon FairMast
claims.claim: Plukon describes FairMast as a slower-growing chicken system with additional space and outdoor-climate areas and states that FairMast corresponds to German retail Haltungsform level 3 'Außenklima'.
claims.boundary: A programme standard does not establish participation by all Plukon growers or quantify realised welfare outcomes for every flock.
claims.falsification_condition: A current FairMast or Haltungsform standard changes the programme requirements or classification.
